# Token categories

Use these categories when extracting the implemented design system.

| Category | What to record | Example from this repository |
|---|---|---|
| Colour | Hex values, semantic role, and declaring selector | `#00ff41` in `.text-neutral-12` and `.border-neutral-6` |
| Typography | Font families, sizes, weights, and rendering settings | `:root` sets `'Courier New', 'Monaco', 'Menlo', 'Consolas', monospace` |
| Spacing | Gap, margin, padding, width, height, and max-height utilities | `.gap-2` sets `gap: 0.5rem` |
| Border and radius | Border width, style, colour, and radius values | `.rounded-lg` sets `border-radius: 0` |
| Layout utility | Display, alignment, grid, position, and object-fit utilities | `.grid-cols-1` sets one column |
| Component class | Named component selectors and their roles | `.card` defines the terminal card surface |
| Motion | Animations and transitions | `crt-flicker` runs on `body` |
| State | Hover, focus, active, disabled, and responsive states | `.btn:disabled` lowers opacity and blocks pointer feedback |
